Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the call today — great to learn more about Acme Health's roadmap for clinical workflows. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Redwood fit: Dedicated inference for PHI/regulated workloads and private deployment options (VPC / on-prem) we discussed.
- Security ask: you mentioned procurement will need SOC 2 Type II report, a bridge letter if our latest Type II report doesn't cover the required time period, and access to our trust portal for questionnaire evidence.

Next steps I can own:
1) Get you the SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter.
2) Share a trust-portal invite and temporary access so your InfoSec team can review evidence.
3) Put you in touch with our security lead for any questionnaire or additional attestation items.

Can you confirm the security contact you want us to share portal access with (name + email) and your desired timeline? Also let me know if Acme requires any specific wording in the bridge letter for procurement.

Thanks — I’ll aim to get the documents to you by end of week.

Best,
